integrity: Exact formula is proved by double subspace-lattice Möbius inversion. Finite checks support, but do not prove, the general all-prime-power formula.
limitations: Counts labelled finite-field representations, not isomorphism types. The geometric top/socle component classification was already known (Bleher–Chinburg–Huisgen-Zimmermann 2014); the claim is an exact arithmetic refinement. Independently audited priority is not established.
title: Exact radical–socle profiles and a finite-field duality law for square-zero local modules
